user.title: Freebox
user.description:
Please enter your Freebox details.
You can check this link to obtain the values: {api_url}

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of your Freebox router.

link.title: Link Freebox router
link.description: Select **Submit**, then touch the right arrow on the router to register Freebox with Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authorize Freebox
reauth_confirm.description: The Freebox token expired or is missing. Select **Submit**, then press the right arrow on the Freebox Server.

permission.title: Permission is required
permission.description: Open {accounts_url} and grant the access policy: "Gestion de l'alarme et maison connectée".

error.register_failed: Failed to register, please try again
error.invalid_token: Invalid or expired token. It has been automatically deleted. Press the right arrow button on your Freebox to re-authorize Home Assistant.

init.title: Freebox Homexa options
init.description: LAN clients are phones, PCs and IoT hosts seen by the Freebox. Freebox Server, repeaters and Home devices are not affected. Since Home Assistant 2026.8, devices are no longer merged across integrations.

data.create_lan_devices: Create a Homexa device for each LAN client

data_description.track_lan_clients: Disable this if presence is already handled by another integration.
data_description.create_wifi_sensors: RSSI is added when a client is seen on Wi-Fi, including after the first setup.
data_description.create_lan_devices: Turn off to keep tracker and RSSI as standalone entities and avoid duplicate devices.

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Reload Freebox Homexa, reconnect and rediscover devices.

remote.name: Send remote command
remote.description: Send a remote command to Freebox Player

code.name: Command Code
code.description: The code of the command to send (e.g., power, play, pause).
